Name: Ginger Island Tortoises
Author: IllogicalMoodSwing
Description:
Look, we all agree that the Ginger Island turtles are a [i]little[/i] goofy, right? Their shells are the size of a literal house! Their heads are so pointy!

Therefore, I've once again taken it upon myself to not only redraw some sprites, but to inflict them on the community. Hope you like 'em 👉👈


Install
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Download and unzip into Stardew Valley/Mods.
